title: Hide a field while retaining its model value
summary: Keep the model value with resetOnHide: false while checking control registration separately.

fact_links.support: Supports skipping hide-time model clearing; does not promise continued control registration.
Supports removal from the parent control tree when the associated fields are hidden.
Supports re-registering the keyed control when shown.
Supports the hide expression used here.
Supports explicit detectChanges after changing the local visibility state.

conditions: Single keyed Material input; no other field shares its key/control.
The form has been mounted before setHidden is called.
limits: This is value retention, not presentation-only hiding or an accessibility recipe.
Shared-key exceptions and resetOnHide: true are separate cases.
Do not infer an application submission payload from model retention or Angular form.value alone.
prerequisites: Formly core and Material 6.3.12; candidate fixture pins Angular/Material 18.2.14.
Import ReactiveFormsModule, FormlyModule.forRoot(), and FormlyMaterialModule; mount the returned form/model/fields/options using formly-form.
Call the factory once per mounted form; these are original illustrations, not upstream example excerpts.
assertions: Initially name is registered and model.name is Ada.
After setHidden(true), model.name stays Ada but form.get("name") is null.
After setHidden(false), name is registered again with value Ada.

verification.details: Original candidate illustration executed with pinned Angular JIT TestBed and Material in headless Chrome. All 17 bounded fixture assertions passed, including supplementary reset-on-hide and shared-key cases; TypeScript noEmit passed. This is not whole-library or cross-version qualification.
